hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit" 2>/dev/null; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo "[branch-guard] Cannot commit to main/master. Create a feature branch first." && exit 2; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -q "\.test\." 2>/dev/null; then echo "[test-quality] Test file modified. Run /test-quality to review."; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr " " "\n" | grep -qE "\.tsx?$" 2>/dev/null && echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr " " "\n" | grep -E "\.tsx?$" | grep -qvE "(\.test\.|schema/|types/|\.d\.ts$)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[best-practices] Source file modified. Apply /best-practices patterns: functional style, single-responsibility components, no any, named exports, early returns."; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE "(schema|models|entities)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[migration-review] Schema file modified. Run /migration-review to check if a migration is needed."; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE "(api|routes|controllers|endpoints)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[api-review] API route modified. Verify: auth applied, input validated, error responses consistent."; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr " " "\n" | grep -qE "\.(tsx?|css)$" 2>/dev/null; then FILES=$(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr " " "\n" | grep -E "\.(tsx?|css)$" | grep -v "\.test\."); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then VIOLATIONS=$(echo "$FILES" | xargs grep -lE "(text|bg|border|ring|divide)-\[#|(text|bg|border)-\[rgba\(" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$VIOLATIONS" ]; then echo "[theme-review] Inline hex color detected in: $VIOLATIONS. Use semantic design tokens. Run /theme-review for details."; fi; fi; fi'
